Updated the federal-debt Treasury Bulletin skill and memory.

Generalizable lesson saved: for U.S. federal fiscal-year-end debt before FY1977, the fiscal year ended June 30, not September 30. For FY1960/FY1961/FY1962 debt questions, use the June 30 debt outstanding figures, then apply annual-average CPI-U calendar-year ratios for inflation adjustment.
